events.evidence: Acht weitere Werkstattoriginale wurden gelesen, ausschließlich privat kopiert und durch acht unabhängige Text- und SHA-256-Vergleiche abgesichert. Historische Produktanforderungen wurden mit Originalpositionen geprüft; keine integrierte E12-Suchmaschine nachgewiesen.

Acht weitere bereits inventarisierte Werkstattdokumente wurden vollständig gelesen und ausschließlich privat durch unabhängige SHA-256-Vergleiche und Ablageprüfungen abgesichert. Externe Primärquellen bleiben separat ungeprüft; keine Softwareintegration.

Acht zusätzliche zuvor inventarisierte Werkstattdokumente wurden als aktuelle Google-Docs-Originaltexte gelesen, ausschließlich privat kopiert und unabhängig mittels Text-, SHA-256- und Ablageprüfung bestätigt. Historische Aussagen über Datenexporte wurden als Quellenhinweise, nicht als verifizierte Rohdatenintegration bewertet.

Acht zusätzliche bereits inventarisierte Werkstattoriginale wurden vollständig gelesen und ausschließlich privat als unabhängige Google-Docs-Kopien gesichert. Volltextlängen, SHA-256-Prüfsummen und private Elternordner stimmen bei allen acht überein; Produktvision anhand von Originalpositionen erneut geprüft. Kein persistenter E12-Index nachgewiesen.

Acht zuvor inventarisierte Google-Docs-Quellen wurden zusätzlich als vollständige private Textkopien gesichert. Alle acht Volltexte und SHA-256-Werte stimmen beim unabhängigen Rücklesen überein; Quellstatus, Ablageort und historischer Checkpoint wurden verifiziert. Keine vollständige rekursive Inventur oder persistente SQLite-Integration.

Acht weitere zuvor inventarisierte Werkstattdokumente als vollständige aktuelle Google-Docs-Texte gelesen, privat kopiert und durch unabhängigen Volltext-, SHA-256- und Elternordnerabgleich geprüft. Direkte Werkstattinventur zusätzlich über drei echte Provider-Seiten (100+100+72) bestätigt; übrige Baumstruktur und SQLite-Integration weiterhin offen.

Acht zuvor inventarisierte Werkstatt-Originale wurden neu als vollständige aktuelle Google-Docs-Texte privat gesichert; 8/8 unabhängige Volltext- und SHA-256-Vergleiche sowie private Elternordnerprüfung bestanden. Zwei gleich nummerierte, aber unterschiedliche Quellen-IDs getrennt erfasst. Referenzierte Fremdquellen und integrierter E12-SQLite-Index bleiben ungeprüft.

Eight additional native-document originals independently re-read and matched with privately stored full-text copies and SHA-256 digests; private parent and access metadata checked, append-only checkpoint retained. Wider inventory and persistent index remain incomplete.

Eight previously unprocessed native workshop documents privately copied; independent original-versus-copy text comparisons (8/8), individual private-parent and unshared checks (8/8), and append-only manifest checkpoint backread verified. Broad recursion and persistent E12 ingestion remain open.

Eight additional previously unprocessed current native-document originals independently matched to complete private native copies, with validated text SHA-256, unchanged private parent metadata and an append-only checkpoint. Cross-document naming and intermediate-report rules traced to exact text positions; referenced destination files remain unverified.

Acht zuvor nicht verarbeitete native Werkstattquellen vollständig über den verbundenen Drive-Zugriff gelesen und ausschließlich privat kopiert. Acht von acht unabhängigen Volltext- und SHA-256-Abgleichen sowie private Elternordner- und Freigabeprüfungen bestanden. Historische Quellhinweise ausdrücklich von ungeprüften Audio- und Chat-Primärdaten getrennt; kein dauerhafter E12-SQLite-Index nachgewiesen.

Acht weitere bisher unerschlossene native Werkstattquellen als aktuelle Volltexte mit vollständigen privaten Kopien gesichert; 8/8 unabhängige Quell-Kopie-Textvergleiche und SHA-256-Prüfungen sowie private Elternordner- und Freigabeprüfungen bestanden. Historische Produktvisions- und Ideenarchiv-Aussagen an konkrete Originaltextpositionen zurückgeführt, ohne die genannten Fremdquellen oder einen persistenten E12-Index als unabhängig geprüft auszugeben. House-Inventur bleibt offen.

Acht zuvor unverarbeitete native Werkstattoriginale vollständig ausschließlich privat kopiert; unabhängiger Volltext- und SHA-256-Abgleich sowie Elternordner- und Nichtfreigabeprüfung jeweils 8/8 bestanden. Historische Regeln zur Quellenrücklese und getrennten Chat-Berichten anhand von Originaltextpositionen geprüft. Eine weitere Unterordner-Ebene paginiert inventarisiert; Fremdquellen und dauerhafte E12-Integration weiterhin offen.

Acht weitere bislang unverarbeitete native Werkstattdokumente ausschließlich privat gesichert; acht unabhängige aktuelle Original-Kopie-Volltext- und SHA-256-Abgleiche sowie acht Elternordner- und Nichtfreigabeprüfungen bestanden. Eine weitere Unterordnerebene metadata-basiert inventarisiert und eine historische Produktidee anhand einer Originaltextposition bestätigt. Verlinkte Medienquellen und dauerhafte E12-Integration weiterhin offen.

Eight additional native workshop documents were verified against private full-paragraph-text copies with matching checksums and folder checks; original passages substantiate an early guided-workflow concept, not deployed independent software.

Eight previously unprocessed native workshop documents privately copied and independently backread with exact paragraph-text and matching SHA-256 checksums; all eight source/copy parent checks and private visibility checks passed. Historical draft review and source-control concepts confirmed as documentation, not deployed software.

Vier weitere früheste native Werkstattdokumente wurden als vollständige aktuelle Absatztexte ausschließlich privat kopiert; vier unabhängige Original-Kopie-Text- und SHA-256-Abgleiche sowie vier Elternordner- und Nichtfreigabeprüfungen bestanden. Historische Austausch- und Quellprüfregeln anhand von Originalpositionen bestätigt; drei native Werkstattquellen und die dauerhafte E12-Integration bleiben offen.

Reconciliation of the paginated 269-document workshop inventory with available private source-copy receipts identified at least ten native source IDs without individually traceable completion evidence, rather than the previously reported three. Four such sources were now independently read and privately verified by exact source-copy text and SHA-256 checks (three nonempty; one confirmed empty). Six identified records remain pending; no global completeness claim is made.

Six previously unpaired native workshop source IDs were independently verified against private full-text copies with exact normalized paragraph-text and matching SHA-256 checks; source/copy parent and private sharing status verified. Paginated source-ID reconciliation remains incomplete, so no global coverage claim is made.

Historical source-ID/hash-receipt reconciliation corrected an earlier undercount against a paginated native-document inventory; fourteen previously unparsed private receipts were recovered and two source-copy text/parent/privacy checks independently repeated. This is receipt-audit progress, not a claim of full corpus completeness or software integration.

A bounded audit of eleven archived workshop-source checkpoints recovered 64 previously uncorrelated source-ID/checksum receipt references and privately merged them into the live manifest against a paginated 269-ID current workshop inventory. Two selected original/private-copy pairs were independently reread with exact paragraph-text equality, correct parent locations, and private sharing status. These are receipt-audit links, not proof of total corpus completeness or Python/SQLite integration.

A private audit reconciled eight archived native-document source ID/checksum receipts against previously unmatched inventory entries, while two other previously metadata-only native sources were copied and independently verified by full normalized text, SHA-256, source/copy parent locations and private sharing status. Two archived pairs were also freshly backread. The result is source-receipt reconciliation and bounded verified copy progress, not a claim of corpus completeness or Python integration.

Three previously metadata-only native-document originals in a bounded workshop folder were privately copied and independently verified against the originals by full normalized paragraph-text equality, SHA-256, exact parent folders and non-shared copy metadata. A newly paginated inventory returned 269 distinct native-document IDs across three pages; each now has a source-ID-to-private-receipt association, without asserting full historical revalidation, complete parent-tree inventory, or persistent Python indexing.

Three previously metadata-only Word originals were preserved as private byte-identical copies, with full raw-file SHA-256 comparisons, connector-extracted text agreement and verified Drive parent and non-shared metadata. One additional native project document was independently checked by complete paragraph-text equality and normalized SHA-256. New paginated folder-level inventories identified an updated root folder count and opened further recursive branches. No persistent Python index or full-Drive completeness is claimed.

Three previously unindexed native-document originals in two newly traversed source branches were privately copied and independently back-read, with identical complete normalized paragraph text, SHA-256 hashes, original and private-copy parent checks and non-shared copy metadata. Bounded recursive provider inventories established exact immediate subfolder and document-type page results in source, control and archive branches without asserting an all-MIME or complete-Drive scan. Persistent Python/SQLite integration remains unverified.

A bounded, fully paginated source inventory established 186 numbered corrected text records versus 185 machine-transcript records. An exact numbering audit found one repeated sequence number with two different source IDs and nonidentical paragraph texts; both distinct variants and a third source were independently preserved and verified by full normalized text, SHA-256, private parent location and sharing state. Six chronicle-test child folders were recursively inventoried to a total of 13 metadata-only documents. Counts refer to this bounded source scope, not all files or complete source-media validation.

Three previously metadata-only native chronicle-test documents and one machine-text source were copied to a verified private archive and independently backread with exact full text and matching SHA-256 checks. A numbered corrected-transcript document pair was traced to the same machine-text original: the substantive transcript text matches, while only heading and status differ. The conclusion is source-provenance clarification, not separate audio validation or persistent Python index integration.

Three previously metadata-only native chronicle-test originals from two bounded source branches were privately copied and independently back-read with identical complete normalized paragraph text, matching SHA-256 checks, verified original and private parent folders, and non-shared copies. The bounded source inventory now has individual source-to-copy receipts for six of thirteen documents; the remaining seven, historic revisions, media assets, and persistent Python integration remain open.

Three previously metadata-only native chronicle-test documents from two bounded test folders were independently copied into a verified private archive and checked against their complete source paragraph texts with identical SHA-256 values, source-to-copy IDs, private parent location and non-shared copies. The bounded chronicle-test inventory now has direct individual verification receipts for nine of thirteen known native documents; four remain metadata-only. Historical test status is not a live day closure, and persistent Python/SQLite integration remains unverified.

Four previously metadata-only native documents in the last two bounded chronicle-test folders were independently preserved in a private archive and verified against full ordered source-paragraph text, with checked source-to-copy IDs, UTF-8 SHA-256 source digests, private parent folders, and non-shared copies. Individual evidence receipts now cover all thirteen native documents in this specific six-folder test branch; this is not a whole-Drive, media, revisions, or persistent Python-index completion claim.

A bounded recursive-source audit documented direct children in eight private archival folders, identified historic export containers without assuming complete attachment coverage, and verified three previously unprocessed native or Markdown source texts against independent private copies and original rereads with matching normalized SHA-256 digests. Source-to-copy parents and private visibility were checked. This is a private source bridge, not whole-drive completion or a persistent Python/SQLite index.

Seven bounded Claude-export folder scopes were paginated by document and folder type, yielding 141 distinct metadata records. Two complete original Markdown sources were independently preserved as byte-identical, SHA-256-verified private copies with checked parent locations and private sharing. A reproducible two-case audit showed that two split-file pairs exactly reconstitute their corresponding full master texts after removing generated wrapper headers; the split files must not be double-counted as distinct conversations. An in-run Python/SQLite FTS5 test indexed 3,315 lines from the two complete sources. Whole-Drive all-MIME coverage and persistent Python integration remain unverified.

Three previously metadata-only archived Markdown master transcripts from three independently paginated private source folders were copied into the authorized private archive and independently re-downloaded byte-for-byte with matching complete SHA-256 digests, source/copy parent IDs and non-shared status. All six related split-file variants were reconstructed exactly as their respective full masters after stripping generated wrappers; they are not six additional conversations. The three full sources were indexed in an isolated in-run SQLite FTS5 test (8,075 original lines), not a durable production index. Whole-Drive and media coverage remain open.

Three previously metadata-only nested archival folders were completely paginated for document/folder types. Three canonical Markdown originals were independently copied to the authorized private archive and re-downloaded byte-for-byte with matching SHA-256 digests and verified non-shared destination parents. Eight split variants were audited: two reconstructed their master texts exactly after generated wrappers were removed, while one had 549 CRLF-vs-LF newline differences but matched completely after line-ending normalization. An in-run Python SQLite FTS5 check indexed 15,695 original lines and verified original line positions; permanent Python integration, other MIME types and whole-Drive inventory remain open. No source text is public.

Three previously unprocessed private archival subfolders were separately paginated by document and folder type, identifying 10 Markdown source records. Three canonical original sources were preserved in the authorized private archive and independently re-downloaded byte-for-byte with matching SHA-256 digests, verified private destination parent and non-shared status. All seven related split variants reconstructed their respective canonical master bytes exactly after generated export wrappers were removed, preventing double-counting. An isolated in-run SQLite FTS5 test indexed 23,126 anchored original text lines. Other MIME types, whole-Drive inventory, historical revisions and durable Python integration remain unverified. No original private text was published.

Three previously unprocessed private archival leaf folders were fully enumerated (11 raw Markdown files) and checked for immediate-child completeness. Three canonical master originals were independently copied and byte-for-byte SHA-256 verified against their private copies, including parent IDs and non-shared permissions. Eight related split files were independently hash-audited: their generated wrappers plus a previously unrecognized two-byte overlap at each of five adjoining boundaries had to be removed; all three reconstructed originals then matched their masters byte-for-byte. An isolated in-run SQLite FTS5 audit indexed 28,714 original lines and verified anchored term results. Split files were not double-counted as conversations. Whole-Drive recursion, historical revisions, binary media and persistent Python integration remain unverified. No private original text is public.
